description: PPxY conservation across insect and chordate DGCR2/IDD (PTHR15256) family members
code:
import requests, json, re
import numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def usearch(q, size=500):
    out=[]; url="https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search"
    params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,id,organism_name,length,sequence","format":"json","size":500}
    r=requests.get(url, params=params, timeout=300)
    j=r.json(); out+=j.get("results",[])
    return out

def tab(res):
    rows=[]
    for e in res:
        s=e["sequence"]["value"]
        pp=[m.start()+1 for m in re.finditer(r"PP.Y", s)]
        rows.append(dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"], org=e["organism"]["scientificName"], L=len(s),
                         npp=len(pp), pos=pp[0] if pp else np.nan,
                         ctx=s[max(0,pp[0]-11):pp[0]+13] if pp else "", seq=s))
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)

ins = tab(usearch("(xref:panther-PTHR15256) AND (taxonomy_id:50557)"))
full = ins[ins.L>=300].copy()
print(f"Insecta PTHR15256: n={len(ins)} total, n={len(full)} with length>=300 (non-fragment)")
print(f"  of full-length: {(full.npp>0).sum()}/{len(full)} = {(full.npp>0).mean():.3f} carry >=1 PPxY")
print(f"  short (<300aa, likely fragments): {(ins[ins.L<300].npp>0).sum()}/{(ins.L<300).sum()} carry PPxY")
print("  PPxY count distribution among full-length:", full.npp.value_counts().to_dict())
print("  n distinct genera (full-length, PPxY+):", full[full.npp>0].org.str.split().str[0].nunique())

# vertebrates/chordates for comparison
ver = tab(usearch("(xref:panther-PTHR15256) AND (taxonomy_id:7711) AND (reviewed:true)"))
print(f"\nChordata reviewed PTHR15256: n={len(ver)}")
print(ver[["acc","org","L","npp","ctx"]].to_string(max_colwidth=30))

# ---- Drosophila genus ----
dro = tab(usearch("(xref:panther-PTHR15256) AND (taxonomy_id:7215)"))
dro = dro[dro.L>=600].drop_duplicates("org")
print(f"\nDrosophila genus full-length members: {len(dro)}")
print(dro[["acc","org","L","npp","pos","ctx"]].to_string(max_colwidth=30))

full.to_csv("/tmp/insecta_pthr15256_full.csv", index=False)
dro.to_csv("/tmp/drosophila_pthr15256.csv", index=False)

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(13,4.2))
ax[0].hist(full.loc[full.npp>0,"pos"], bins=30, color="#4C78A8")
ax[0].axvline(193, color="#E45756", lw=2, label="D. melanogaster CG42404, PPPY at 193")
ax[0].set_xlabel("position of first PPxY (residue)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("number of insect proteins")
ax[0].set_title("PPxY position in insect DGCR2/IDD family (PTHR15256)"); ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)

cnt = full.npp.value_counts().sort_index()
ax[1].bar(cnt.index.astype(str), cnt.values, color=["#B0B0B0","#4C78A8","#72B7B2"][:len(cnt)])
ax[1].set_xlabel("number of PPxY motifs per protein"); ax[1].set_ylabel("count")
ax[1].set_title(f"PPxY copy number, insect PTHR15256 >=300 aa (n={len(full)})")
for i,(k,v) in enumerate(cnt.items()): ax[1].text(i, v+1, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
